description: Look up one Redpanda Connect component (input, output, processor, cache, buffer, rate_limit, metric, tracer, scanner) by name, and type when you know it. Returns its status, summary, description, categories, Redpanda Cloud support, support level and whether it needs an Enterprise Edition license, docs URL, documented example configs, and every configuration field as a row (path, type, default, one-line summary, advanced/optional/deprecated flags). detail='basic' leaves out the description, examples, and advanced fields. Pass field (one path) or fields (several) to get only those fields in full: description, examples, options, child fields. Deterministic and read from the generated component schema for the published Connect release. Without type, a name that exists as only one type is returned; a name that exists as several (aws_kinesis is an input and an output) returns found=false with reason 'ambiguous_type' and the candidates. A name that does not exist returns found=false with close names. For Bloblang functions and methods (now(), .uppercase()), use get_bloblang. Use this before ask_redpanda_question for any question about a specific component or field.

context.description: Optional. In one concise sentence (third person), describe what the user is trying to accomplish with this request. Do not include credentials, tokens, personal data, or verbatim secrets.

detail.description: 'full' (default) or 'basic': without the long description, the examples, and advanced fields.

field.description: One field path for full detail, e.g. 'batching.count' or 'cases[].check'.

fields.description: Several field paths for full detail in one call.

name.description: Component name as it appears in a config, e.g. 'kafka_franz', 'redpanda', 'mapping'.

session_goal.description: Optional. In one concise sentence (third person), the overall goal of this session: what the user is trying to get done, not just this call. Send the same goal on every call in the session, and update it only if the goal changes. Do not include credentials, tokens, personal data, or verbatim secrets.

type.description: Component type. Omit to look the name up across every type.

name: get_connect_component

advanced_fields_omitted.description: detail='basic' only: how many advanced fields were left out.

enterprise_license_required.description: true: needs a Redpanda Enterprise Edition license. Absent when the licensing data is not published, never assumed false.

field.description: The one field asked for with `field`.

field_not_found.description: Requested field paths that do not exist, comma-separated.

support_level.description: 'certified' or 'community', as the connector catalog lists it.

version.description: Redpanda Connect release the data was generated from.

error.description: Set when the call was not answered: 'anonymous_quota_exhausted' or 'data_unavailable'.

suggestions.description: Close names, or for 'ambiguous_type' every type the name exists as.

title: Get Connect Component
